title: Typography as Meaning — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Typography as Meaning's rich face, its first round, a Study and still a proposal. Two made walks test the page's grammar: one reads it blind, one part at a time, and asks the reader before any label shows; the other puts all 120 answer-sets through the page's own lettering function and runs it backwards, to count what the form can give back. Beside them sit the page's two proofs and BLUELINE's renders, gathered as they were. I grow when the page is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

offers.what: Counted on whos-talking.html's own letter() over all 120 answer-sets: 80 forms to the eye (95 to a ruler, 58 if size isn't read). Inside or outside reads back 120/120, so the missed margin caption was a matter of being seen, not of the mark being absent. To whom reads back least (80/120): in the margin, "to B" and "to us" differ by 2 px. Source outranks emotion only on the balloon and the face. The feeling moves into size and case, so a menacing radio differs from a calm one only by 24 → 30 px; the narrator takes size and case too, and inside the story its five feelings make 2 forms. A possible line: 'Run as a function, the precedence is per channel: the source takes the balloon and the face, the feeling keeps size and case, and only the narrator takes everything.'

In BLUELINE's canny sweep (one bleeding 'too late' bubble, control 0.35 and 0.5 × end 0.4 and 0.7, four renders), the word reads in all four and the guide's tail is gone in all four; at 0.35 the balloon body dissolves too. Seen by eye in four images of one word, so it is not a measure. If it holds, the model can supply the material for the word and the body, but the tail (the part that says who and to whom) has to be drawn last, by the letterer, the way Comic Chat routes tails last. A possible clause after 'let the model supply the material': '…and keep the tail for last: in BLUELINE's sweep the renders kept the word and lost the tail every time.'

pieces.file: Typography as Meaning — rich — the grammar, blind.html
pieces.title: the grammar, blind · a walk in four steps
pieces.caption: **Read the grammar before the labels.** One part changes at a time, and you order or name the forms before the key shows: weight (quiet to loud), case (private to public), hand or type (the author or someone in the story), and last the balloon's outline alone, with no tail and the same words in all seven. Then the tally against chance. One reader is a sign, not a measurement.

verdicts.file: Typography as Meaning — rich — the grammar, blind.html
verdicts.why: A test: the reader can fall to chance and the verdict says so; chance levels exact (n(n−1)/4 pairs, 1 in n!; 1 of 7 named), key locked until every answer is given, shuffles leak no order. Note: start-over after the key lets a reader retry unmarked.
